opportunities.name: GitHub user lead research and hiring email draft
opportunities.description: Search a GitHub username, open the user's profile and top repo, then compose an email to the hiring address with a lead summary (followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post) for a given role.
steps: Click GitHub global search and type the username
Press Enter and click the 'Users' results filter
Open the top/pinned repo and note stars and language
Open mail compose, enter To hiring@example.com
Enter body with followers, top repo, stars, language, latest post
